create_empty_sdf_collider: create an empty SDFCollider with default world-space parent and zero translation
create_sdf_collider_with_parent: create an SDFCollider with a custom translation vector and parent joint index
create_sdf_collider_with_sdf: create an SDFCollider bound to a SignedDistanceField with translation and parent joint
test_sdf_collider_rotation: test that an SDFCollider stores and returns a quaternion rotation correctly
test_sdf_collider_repr: test the SDFCollider repr output includes parent index and validity status
